name: Simon I
note: Lordship of Lippe; reunited the lordship (source also lists son Simon II, d. 1334, as co-ruler, unclear)

name: Otto
note: co-ruler with his brother Bernard V

name: Simon V
note: during his rule the lordship became the County of Lippe (1528)

name: Simon VI
note: after his death the county was divided (Detmold main line followed here)

name: Simon Philip
note: County of Detmold; died with no descendants

name: Leopold I
note: county elevated to Principality of Lippe during his rule

name: Leopold II
note: Principality of Lippe; regency of his mother 1802-1820
